Name: Stardew Motif
Author: Vinyks
Description:
[center]Note: This Mod does not fully reflect who these VTubers are in real life.[/center]
This Mod changes certain characters to fit the Visuals of the german VTubers Mona Euphelia, Finstey, Lunywoo, Jinja, Laphipi and Nayami from Lightmotif.
[list]
[*]Leah -> Mona Euhpelia
[*]Sam -> Finstey
[*]Abigail -> Lunywoo
[*]Robin -> Jinja
[*]Penny -> Laphipi
[*]Emily -> Nayami
[/list]
[b]The mod features only English and German localization[/b]
The mod furthermore changes some items and dialogue to better fit with the Lore and or the Style of named VTubers.
This mod features tons of References to these VTubers and their Community

Manifest.Name: StardewMotif
Manifest.Description: Replaces Abigail, Leah, Sam, Penny, Robin and Emily; with the popular german Vtubers: Luny, Mona, Fin, Laphi, Jinja and Nayami
Manifest.Author: Vinyks
